evidenceContract.userBehavior: Ask the Agent to generate one image; the single official Generation Tool call remains active until the exact durable Job succeeds or fails.

observables.description: One official Generation Tool call; exact Generation Job identity; owning coordinator and observer; exact-turn Workspace Board Job/result projection; terminal result locator or explicit failure; and forbidden polling/fallback facts.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The single openneko_generation submit Tool call projects one canonical Generation node into the turn-selected Workspace Board, keeps the exact JobRef visible while running, and binds the canonical Workspace result locator into that same node after success without duplicates.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: A pending Tool success, missing Job identity/result locator, missing or blocked Workspace Board projection, duplicate projection, model-authored polling, direct provider or generic Task participation, Canvas fallback, or hidden terminal Job failure fails.

steps.prompt: Generate one image of a simple red circle on white. Wait for the official Generation Tool to finish and report the resulting artifact. Do not poll with additional Tool calls, do not use a generic Task, and do not choose a provider or model yourself.
